validation.note: The native PLAYERDATA_TAKEOVER_TUNING object exposes rank, MyPLAYER requirements, NBA requirements, and AttributeModifier. No separate height/position eligibility table is present in this object.

attribute_modifier_interpretation.note: The rank-indexed values are present in NBA 2K HQ tuning, but no verified HQ gameplay callsite applies them to player ratings. Do not apply them as an attribute/GNR bonus or penalty without main-game evidence.
